quandoUsar: Showing how the mix of several parts changes over time, when the overall shape matters more than exact values: tickets by topic, traffic by channel.
When the reader wants to isolate one part: pointing at a layer or its legend entry fades the others, and the tooltip reads values point by point.
Switching between periods of different lengths: layers are resampled onto a common grid and transform from one dataset to the other.
quandoEvitar: Use `line-chart` when the reader needs to compare exact values across series: here only the layer's thickness is readable, and the baseline undulates.
Use `bump-chart` when what matters is each series' ranking position in each period.
Use `composition-chart` or `donut-chart` for the split of a total at a single moment.

teclado.acao: With focus on the chart, step back or forward one point in time.
Switch the highlighted layer, following the order of `series`.
Move forward or back about a sixth of the period.
Go to the first or last point.
In the legend, hide or show the focused button's layer.
Ends the reading and hides the tooltip.

acessibilidade: The chart area is a focusable group with `aria-roledescription="stream graph"`; on receiving focus by keyboard, reading starts at the most recent point.
An `aria-live="polite"` region reads the current point, the highlighted layer with its value, and the total; a hidden summary and table carry all the data.
The legend is a group of buttons with `aria-pressed` (pressed = layer visible); the table's first column header comes from `categoryLabel`, which defaults to `Date`.
movimento: The first time on screen, the flow opens from a thread along the center; new data makes each layer transform on a spring from its current shape.
Hiding a layer through the legend thins it until it vanishes while the others close the gap; the crosshair glides between points and the tooltip follows on its own spring.
With “reduced motion” on, layers go straight to the final state and the crosshair and tooltip jump.
responsivo: The width follows the container and the height is the `height` prop (260 px); the axis shows at most one `axisLabel` every 72 px, counting from the most recent.
The name inside a layer only appears where it is at least 19 px thick and the text fits; on thin layers, identification is left to the legend and tooltip.
desempenho: Drawing is imperative: on every animation frame all layers have their path rebuilt with 161 samples and the baseline recomputed, so the cost grows with the number of layers.
notasIA: Pass `series` (`{ key, label, color? }`) and `data` with a `values` object per point, indexed by the series `key`; missing or negative values count as zero.

The order of `series` runs from the center outward: the first runs through the middle and the rest alternate above and below; only the first four get a series color, and the rest stay neutral without `color`.
`offset="zero"` stacks from a straight base and `offset="silhouette"` centers the stack; `hiddenSeries` with `onHiddenSeriesChange` controls the hidden layers.
